# RU Platform — Agent Instructions

## 🔎 Purpose
Provide concise, actionable guidance so an AI coding agent can be immediately productive in this Laravel backend.

## 🏗 Big picture / architecture
- This is a **Laravel** API-first backend (classic MVC). Key directories:
  - `routes/api.php` — public & protected endpoints (see examples below).
  - `app/Http/Controllers` — business logic and validation live here (controllers use `$request->validate`).
  - `app/Models` — Eloquent models (`User`, `Dish`, `Menu`, `Order`, `Payment`, `Ingredient`, ...).
  - `database/migrations` & `database/seeders` — schema and initial data. `DatabaseSeeder` creates the default admin.
- Data flows: client -> `routes/api.php` -> controller validation -> Eloquent models -> DB. No external payment gateway (payments are simulated).

Role values: `student`, `staff`, `admin`.    - Use header: `Authorization: Bearer <plain-token>` for protected endpoints.    - POST `/api/auth/login` -> response `{ token: "<plain-token>", user: {...} }`  - Example flow (PowerShell / curl):  - The server stores a **sha256** hash of that token (`User::api_token`), and middleware `ApiTokenAuth` validates `Authorization: Bearer <token>` by hashing and looking up the user.- Login endpoint: `POST /api/auth/login` (see `AuthController`).
